meta.title: Risk register mapped to every decision - Session O
meta.strategies: A=Sell now via 1031 | B=Extend 10-15yr then sell | C=Hold to expiry then sell/re-tenant | D=Renew at expiry & hold | E=Sell now taxable (comparison)

risks.risk: Lease expires dark; tenant vacates at 2030-2035 expiry
risks.impact: Severe: income to zero; price becomes land + box value minus re-tenant cost
risks.exposure: A: none (exited) | B: low if extended | C: HIGH | D: HIGH | E: none
risks.mitigation: SG-02 dual track; SG-10 deadline trigger; Q-01/Q-05

risks.risk: Tenant closure programme reaches this store before expiry
risks.likelihood: Material: system 2168 to 2115 in one year; SSS -4.2% YTD
risks.impact: High: dark-store rent may continue or terminate per lease (unknown, Q-03)
risks.exposure: A: transferred | B: medium | C: HIGH | D: HIGH | E: transferred
risks.mitigation: Q-05 coverage tracking; Q-03 clause review; SG-06

risks.risk: Tenant credit deterioration / bankruptcy; rent rejection in Chapter 11
risks.likelihood: Low-medium; leverage high, SSS negative (verify debt, B08)
risks.impact: Severe: lease rejection caps claim; box dark
risks.exposure: A: none post-sale | B: medium | C/D: HIGH | E: none
risks.mitigation: Q-06 credit tripwire; diversify via A/B; SG-10

risks.risk: Cap-rate expansion (Treasury 4.88% stays high / rises) compresses NNN prices
risks.impact: High on exit price for every strategy
risks.mitigation: Sell/extend while term has value; sensitivity grid on Projection page

risks.risk: Trade-area demand erosion: county population -3.2% since 2020
risks.impact: Medium: sales pool shrinks; replacement rent softens
risks.mitigation: Q-07 ring study; Q-08 DOF verification

risks.risk: Labor-cost squeeze on tenant (fast-food floor $20.00; council may raise by up to CPI/3.5% mechanism)
risks.impact: Medium: franchisee margin; closure/renewal leverage
risks.mitigation: Coverage monitoring SG-06

risks.risk: Food / restaurant inflation persists (LA CPI food-away +0.5% in Oct 2026; YoY series interrupted)
risks.impact: Medium: menu price vs transaction trade-off (transactions already falling)
risks.mitigation: None available to landlord; factor into renewal rent realism

risks.risk: Measure ULA cliff at sale price >$5.4M (4% on full price; >$10.9M: 5.5%)
risks.likelihood: Certain if City-of-LA price crosses threshold
risks.impact: High: ~$216k step at $5.4M, scaling with price
risks.mitigation: SG-04 cliff pricing; Q-04 city-status confirmation

risks.risk: Prop 13 subsidy loss on exchange/purchase (reset to market value)
risks.impact: Medium, compounding annually
risks.mitigation: SG-09 quantify before exchanging

risks.risk: 1031 failure: missed 45-day ID / 180-day close, or overpriced replacement
risks.impact: High: full gain recognized, or deferral bought at bad price
risks.mitigation: SG-08 pipeline first; QI engaged pre-listing

risks.risk: Insurance repricing / non-renewal after Jan 2025 fires
risks.impact: Medium-high: NOI erosion; buyer discount
risks.mitigation: SG-07 early broker market check

risks.risk: Major earthquake (USGS: 60% M6.7+ in region within 30 yrs)
risks.impact: Severe: damage, closure, uninsured gap if EQ declined
risks.mitigation: SG-11 parcel zones + EQ quote; diversification via A/B is the structural hedge

risks.risk: Wildfire / smoke / PSPS disruption at or near parcel
risks.impact: Medium-severe: closure, damage, insurance spiral
risks.mitigation: FHSZ lookup Q-11; defensible-space / hardening capex if holding

risks.risk: Flood / atmospheric river; liquefaction secondary damage
risks.impact: Medium-severe
risks.mitigation: FEMA FIRM + CGS lookup Q-11

risks.risk: Pandemic / civil disruption / extended closure orders
risks.likelihood: Low in any year, non-zero over 10-yr hold
risks.impact: High: QSR drive-thru proved resilient in 2020, dine-in did not; this box format unknown (Q-05)
risks.mitigation: Drive-thru entitlement confirmation Q-04; diversification

risks.risk: Regulatory: drive-thru restrictions, minimum-wage escalation, menu/label or emissions rules raise tenant capex
risks.impact: Medium: renewal rent capacity falls
risks.mitigation: Zoning/entitlement diligence Q-04

risks.risk: Single-asset, single-tenant concentration (owner-level)
risks.impact: High variance of total wealth outcome
risks.mitigation: 1031 into diversified replacement(s); SG-12 normalized monitoring

risks.risk: Interest-rate / refinancing shock on owner debt at maturity
risks.impact: Medium-high if maturity precedes lease expiry
risks.mitigation: Q-16 loan review now, not at maturity

risks.risk: Data risk: deciding on system averages instead of this store's sales
risks.impact: High: wrong renewal probability drives wrong strategy
risks.mitigation: SG-06; treat model as framework until store data arrives

risks.risk: Privacy / disclosure leak of rent, basis, or identity via documents or listings
risks.impact: High: negotiating leverage + personal privacy loss; git history is permanent
risks.mitigation: SG-12; NDA-gated BOVs; offline private worksheet
